prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: coherent animation keyframe sheet for an offline exercise guide. Input 1 is the approved character/style reference only. Preserve that adult muscular man's identity, tan skin, short dark hair, anatomical definition, black shorts, black shoes, realistic colored fitness illustration on warm off-white background. Input 2 is the equipment/action reference for this exercise. Use locked camera, focal length, crop, floor and illumination across EVERY cell. Each cell is the SAME SCENE photographed at a later moment, not nine variants. Skin color, face, body proportions, machine topology, metal surfaces and background must not morph. No labels, no arrows, no watermarks, no borders or gutters. Keep full body and entire apparatus visible inside each cell with generous fixed margins. Machine components are rigid; anchored supports stay pixel-consistent; levers only rotate on their physical axes. Human joints must bend naturally. All hands/feet contact correct supports; no intersections. Create ONE SQUARE 4 by 4 animation contact sheet, exactly sixteen equally sized SQUARE cells, row-major chronological order. Same muscular man holding TWO identical small black hex dumbbells by his sides, demonstrates ALTERNATING FORWARD LUNGES, complete left then right repetition. Fixed three-quarter camera shows both feet and which leg is forward, man faces diagonally right. Feet use two parallel hip-width tracks, never cross. Torso upright, neutral spine, front knee follows foot, rear knee toward floor without impact. Dumbbells hang vertically close to hips, arms straight; neither weights nor body pass through legs. Natural human anatomy and separate limbs every frame. Keyframes: 1 standing feet hip-width; 2 LEFT foot stepping forward; 3 LEFT foot planted and shallow descent; 4 LEFT deeper descent; 5 LEFT bottom both knees near90deg, left/front heel planted and right/rear heel lifted; 6 LEFT rising; 7 pushing back off LEFT/front foot; 8 LEFT foot almost returned to standing. 9 standing again; 10 RIGHT foot stepping forward; 11 RIGHT planted shallow descent; 12 RIGHT deeper descent; 13 RIGHT bottom both knees near90deg, right/front heel planted and left/rear heel lifted; 14 RIGHT rising; 15 pushing back off RIGHT/front foot; 16 RIGHT foot almost returned to standing, ready to loop seamlessly into cell1. IMPORTANT: second half MUST change which anatomical leg leads. Do not repeat a same-leg lunge for the second repetition. Never switch camera, mirror entire person or reverse lighting between legs. Full man+all feet+dumbbells fit every cell with the same crop and scale. No extra motion trails, no labels, no frame numbers.
